arabic text: LA ILAHA ILLALLAH MUHAMMADIN RASOOL ALLAH KI LAAZAWAL DARSGAAH HUSSAIN HAI
english translation text: THE NEVER DECLINING UNIVERSITY OF ‘LA ILAHA ILLALLAH MUHAMMADIN RASOOL ALLAH’ IS HUSSAIN

arabic text: NA JISKI KOI MISAAL HAI NA JISKI KOI NAZEER HAI, WOH BEMISAAL SHEHANSHA HUSSAIN HAI
english translation text: THE ONE WHO DOESN’T HAVE ANYONE LIKE HIM, THAT UNIQUE EMPEROR IS HUSSAIN

arabic text: HUSSAIN LA ILAH KI ZINDAGI, HUSSAIN AMBIYA KI BANDAGI
english translation text: HUSSAIN IS THE LIFE OF ISLAM;\nHUSSAIN IS THE LIFE OF ALL THE PROPHETS.

arabic text: LA ILAH SE POOCH LO KE SAARI KAAINAAT MEIN SIRF BINA-E-LA ILAH HUSSAIN HAI
english translation text: ASK ALLAH, IN THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE, THE SAVIOR OF ISLAM IS HUSSAIN.

arabic text: HUSSAIN DEEN KA SHABAB HAI, HUSSAIN DARD KI KITAAB HAI,
english translation text: HUSSAIN IS THE YOUTH OF RELIGION, HUSSAIN IS THE BOOK OF SUFFERING

arabic text: KAFAN KE BANND KHOL KAR BULAYA JISKO MAAN NE KHUD, WO FATIMA KA LADLA HUSSAIN HAI
english translation text: DESPITE BEING SHROUDED, BIBI FATEMA, CALLED OUT TO HIM, THAT BELOVED OF FATIMA IS HUSSAIN

arabic text: TARAP CHUKI SHABEEH-E-MUSTAFA, MAGAR HUSSAIN HE DATTA HUA,
english translation text: HAZRAT ALI AKBER TREMBLED BUT HUSSAIN WAS STEADFAST

arabic text: PISAR JAWAN KI LAASH PE HAI MUTMAIN KHARA RAHA YE WO KHALIL-E-KARBALA HUSSAIN HAI
english translation text: STANDING CONTENT AT THE BODY OF HIS SON, THAT IBRAHIM OF KARBALA IS HUSSAIN

arabic text: APNE KHOON KA GHUSAL MILA, KAFAN HAI JISKA KHAAK-E-KARBALA
english translation text: HIS GHUSL WAS DONE IN HIS OWN BLOOD, HIS KAFAN WAS THE SAND OF KARBALA

arabic text: DAFAN BEHAN NA KAR SAKI HAI DHOOP MEIN PARA RAHA YE WO GHAREEB-E-KARBALA HUSSAIN HAI,
english translation text: BIBI ZAYNAB COULD NOT BURY HIM, HIS BODY LAY UNDER THE SUN, THAT LONELY MAN OF KARBALA IS HUSSAIN

arabic text: HARAM MEIN HASHR KA SAMA HUA, PHUPHI SE JAB SAKINA NE YE KAHA,
english translation text: IT WAS LIKE THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT WHEN BIBI SAKINA TOLD HER AUNT

arabic text: MUJHE NA NEEND AATI HAI MAIN SOUN KISKE SEENE PAR KAHAN CHALA GAYA MERA HUSSAIN HAI,
english translation text: I CANNOT SLEEP, ON WHOSE CHEST SHOULD I SLEEP ON, WHERE IS MY HUSSAIN?

arabic text: LA ILAHA ILLAH MUHAMMADUR RASOOL ALLAH,\nKI LAAZAWAL DARSGAH HUSSAIN HAI
english translation text: THE NEVER DECLINING UNIVERSITY OF ‘LA ILAHA ILLALLAH MUHAMMADIN RASOOL ALLAH’ IS HUSSAIN
